name: Hemang Resources Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Hemang Resources Ltd is in the business of Coal Trading and Infrastructure.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
HRL, part of the Bhatia Group (Indore), was earlier engaged in asset financing but later surrendered its NBFC license to enter coal trading, sourcing from Indonesia and South Africa for domestic clients. It also traded in commodities like sand and soybeans (now discontinued) and currently focuses on stock-and-sale business catering mainly to small corporations and dealers. Currently, the company trades in all types of Coal, Stevedoring, Logistic services, & Trading in land.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.97 times its book value
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 9.17% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.74 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 1,065 days.
Working capital days have increased from 473 days to 1,129 days
